groups.activity: Skirmish; board the derelict and hack its terminal
groups.meta: one cache roll per mission, paid at mission end
conditions: Only the Grineer Veil nodes drop it: Nsu Grid, Flexa, H-2 Cloud and R-9 Cloud. Corpus Veil nodes pay Carmine Penta instead.
No tower, or a tower with no terminal, pays nothing: abort and relaunch.
An active Sentient Anomaly on the node blocks the derelict; pick another Grineer Veil node while it sits on yours.
bonuses: The same cache rolls the Ignis Wraith Blueprint at 8.70%.
You keep the cache reward if you abort after the bonus rewards appear.
Nsu Grid pays well in Endo and credits even without a Spectra drop.

disclosures.title: fishing for the derelict
disclosures.body: Nsu Grid and H-2 Cloud appear to spawn it every time unless the Anomaly is present. Ignore advice naming Ruse War Field or Gian Point; Ruse War Field is gone. Budget roughly 30 paid-out caches for a full set, with a long tail; one player spread 10-12 tries a day and traded duplicates for the missing piece.

disclosures.title: cutting mission time
disclosures.body: Aim for 6-10 minutes, not 25. Seeker Volley clears fighters, missiles or Shatter Burst drop Skold crewship shields, and a Tycho Forward Artillery shot at a still-glowing engine kills the ship outright. Solo: pilot as Hildryn (shields pay for Railjack abilities), then hand the helm to a Pilot-5 crew gunner from the Tactical menu while you do away objectives, and swap it back after. Harrow's Thurible keeps battle avionics topped up.
